description: Double opt-in subscribe to the The Agents Index digest of new and freshly re-verified agents. Provide an email; returns { ok }. Nothing is sent but one confirmation mail until the person at that address uses its link, which works for 7 days; an unconfirmed address is deleted after 30. Every issue carries a one-click unsubscribe.
